properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 is a pure-JS MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 implementation resolved into the app lockfile as a transitive dependency of elliptic (wallet-adapter stack). No call site in first-party app source; the library ships in the browser bundle regardless. Changeable here by upgrading the wallet stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: secp256k1 (native ECDSA on the secp256k1 curve, ^3.8.0/^4.0.x) and its @types package are resolved and pinned in the app lockfile, reached via @toruslabs/eccrypto and elliptic inside the @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets / @project-serum/anchor wallet stack. Changeable here (transitive dependency the app pins and ships in its bundle); classical signature primitive with a migration deadline, not a harvesting risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.3 is the browserify stand-in for OpenSSL's EVP_BytesToKey (single-round MD5 KDF), pulled in by the browserified crypto used by secp256k1/keccak inside the wallet stack. Changeable here; weak KDF available to the shipped browser bundle, though reached only by transitive wallet code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic@6.5.4 is the pure-JS ECDSA/secp256k1/ECDH implementation the wallet stack bundles for browser use. Changeable here (pinned transitively); quantum-vulnerable ECDSA available in the shipped bundle, called by Torus/wallet adapter code rather than the app's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: curve25519-dalek@3.2.1 (Cargo.lock line 460) is the elliptic-curve core of ed25519-dalek, the signature system Solana transactions use; it enters Cargo.lock transitively via anchor-lang 0.24.2 → solana-program. X25519/Ed25519 curve operations are Shor-vulnerable; the curve code ships with the on-chain program build. Observable here, replaceable only by the anchor/solana upstream versions. Same logical asset as the curve25519-dalek dependency entry LIB-f69df116.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3 (which exposes X25519 scalar-multiplication key agreement alongside Ed25519 and secretbox) is pinned in the app lockfile as a transitive dependency of @project-serum/anchor, used to verify transaction signatures in the browser. X25519 key agreement is Shor-vulnerable and the code ships in the bundle; no first-party call site performs an actual X25519 exchange.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@^3.0.0 — the scrypt memory-hard password KDF — is resolved in the app lockfile, pinned adjacent to secp256k1 in the @toruslabs wallet dependency block. No first-party call site in app/src; it ships in the bundle as transitive wallet code. scrypt itself is PQ-adequate (Grover only halves the work factor); the version pinned matters for its parameters, which live in the wallet library, not here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: sha2@0.9.9 provides SHA-256/SHA-512; it sits in Cargo.lock at line 983 as a transitive dependency of anchor-lang 0.24.2 → solana-program (SHA-256 underpins Solana pubkey/PDA derivation and transaction hashing). No direct use in the program's own source; the crate ships with the program build regardless. Changeable only by upgrading the anchor/solana toolchain upstream of this project.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3's secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption) is pinned in the app lockfile via @project-serum/anchor. Symmetric AE, PQ-adequate against Grover; ships in the browser bundle, no first-party call site in app/src.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge — a full JS TLS/X.509/RSA/AES crypto library — is pinned in the app lockfile as a transitive dependency of selfsigned, which @vue/cli-service uses to serve the dev server over HTTPS. Primarily dev-tooling; no production call site found in the app source, but the library and its classical algorithm surface ship with the toolchain. Changeable here by changing dev-server tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: selfsigned@2.0.1 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (built on node-forge), pulled in by @vue/cli-service for the HTTPS dev server. Dev-only ephemeral trust material — the generated cert is never committed and never a production trust anchor; recorded as X.509 PKI tooling that ships with the frontend toolchain. Changeable here by changing dev-server tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: blake3@1.3.1 (Cargo.lock line 249) — the BLAKE3 hash — enters the lockfile transitively via anchor-lang 0.24.2 → solana-program. No direct use in the program's own source; the crate ships with the build regardless. BLAKE3 is post-quantum-adequate; recorded for completeness of the shipped algorithm set.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hmac@0.8.1 (Cargo.lock line 580) — HMAC message authentication — is a transitive dependency of the anchor-lang 0.24.2 / solana-program build. No direct use in the program's own source; the crate ships with the build regardless. Changeable only by upgrading the anchor/solana toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: curve25519-dalek@3.2.1 in Cargo.lock — the dependency-name view of the same lockfile entry as ALG-82f1eeb2 (Curve25519 curve arithmetic, transitive via anchor-lang → solana-program → ed25519-dalek). Confirmed as the crate the toolchain pins.
